fields.name: blockTitle
fields.label: Section Title
fields.description: Optional heading displayed above the video or playlist

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: How to display multiple videos

fields.name: autoplay
fields.label: Autoplay
fields.description: Automatically play first video on load. Forces mute due to browser policy.

fields.name: muted
fields.label: Muted
fields.description: Start video with sound off

fields.name: loop
fields.label: Loop
fields.description: Continuously loop the video

fields.name: showPlaylist
fields.label: Show Playlist Thumbnails
fields.description: Show thumbnail navigation when multiple videos are added

fields.name: videoSource
fields.label: Video Source
fields.description: Select where the video is coming from

fields.name: videoTitle
fields.label: Video Title
fields.description: Title shown in playlist and used as accessibility label

fields.name: videoDescription
fields.label: Video Description
fields.description: Short description shown below the video or in playlist panel
fields.placeholder: e.g. Bangkok Bank Corporate Social Responsibility Program

fields.name: youtubeUrl
fields.label: YouTube URL
fields.description: Full YouTube video URL. Required when Video Source is YouTube.

fields.name: youtubeId
fields.label: YouTube Video ID
fields.description: Auto-extracted from URL. Override only if needed.

fields.name: orientation
fields.label: Video Orientation
fields.description: Landscape (16:9) for normal videos. Portrait (9:16) for vertical videos.

fields.name: damVideoPath
fields.label: DAM Video File
fields.description: Select video file from Media Library. Required when Video Source is DAM.

fields.name: posterImage
fields.label: Poster / Thumbnail Image
fields.description: Image shown before video plays. For YouTube, auto-fetched if not set.

fields.name: posterAltText
fields.label: Poster Image Alt Text
fields.description: Accessibility description for the thumbnail image

fields.name: overrideAutoplay
fields.label: Autoplay this video
fields.description: Override block-level autoplay setting for this specific video

fields.name: overrideMuted
fields.label: Mute this video
fields.description: Override block-level muted setting for this specific video

fields.name: overrideLoop
fields.label: Loop this video
fields.description: Override block-level loop setting for this specific video

fields.name: hideFromPlaylist
fields.label: Hide from Playlist
fields.description: Exclude this video from playlist thumbnail navigation

fields.name: trackingLabel
fields.label: Analytics Label
fields.description: Custom label for analytics tracking. TBU — reserved for future implementation.
